discussion_comments.comment_body:
The response rate limiting period is maintain by the server side(kong). In the previous `wait`, we just wait on the client side and the wait logic could not guarantee server side start a new second, sometimes when the wait end, server side is still in the tail of old second.
Here we get the timestamp from server, wait until server starts a new second so that is as as close as 1 secs to finish the test iterations, reduce the possibility of flaky.
